rationale: Fix the warm-mode refit ownership path already present in v1.83.0: a changed camera released its hold before the final editor layout. Retain the current camera and settle against the actual editor stage without changing geometry schemas or retry policy.

summary.ru: Камера после поздней загрузки геометрии соответствует рабочей области восстановленного редактора.
summary.en: The camera follows the restored editor stage after a delayed geometry refresh.
